dialogues.speaker: Masa
dialogues.text: Xoctli used to rely on me in the old days. But now, I'm not even needed when it comes time to plow the fields or transport food...

dialogues.speaker: Masa
dialogues.text: What's the meaning of life for a saurian who doesn't even work?

dialogues.speaker: Masa
dialogues.text: Is the only thing left for me... to keep Xoctli's daughter, Cuaxilo, company while she watches the luchador matches?
